name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  August 13, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Chambers,
9th Floor, on August 13, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Victoria Ojeda, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, City Clerk Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Mira Gerges on behalf of the City of Holy Annunciation Coptic Orthodox Church to
  host the Holy Annunciation’s Annual Fundraiser event at 2225 W. Manchester Blvd.,
  Private Property, on Friday, August 21, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Saturday,
  August 22, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.; Sunday, August 23, 2026, from 9:00
  a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Approval for a three (3) day event within a church's private parking
  lot. Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures. Must check in with Building Safety regarding any required
  permits; Applicant to hire a minimum of three (3) professional-licensed security guards
  for the safety of attendees and for traffic control of the parking lot. One security shall be
  at the entrance of the parking lot to serve as a traffic guide for vehicles entering the lot.
  One security guard shall be at the entrance to the pedestrian area to ensure that no
  vehicle movement occurs within it. In addition, a barrier or support barrier shall be in
  place to separate the pedestrian area from the parking lot. Security staff shall wear a
  reflective vest for visibility/risk management reasons. Applicant may use an “off-duty”
  law enforcement officer that is part of their organization in lieu of the security guards. The
  IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol and high visibility will be provided
  as time permits. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws. No Code Enforcement
   conditions; No additional recommendations needed for Fire approval. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No.237213).
  New Business License Request (s):
Item #2:  Nawaz Hussain Khushi on behalf of AAMES Parking to operate as a Commercial
  parking Lot at 1201 S. Prairie Ave, Suite #3. Approval for three (3) day event within a
  church's private parking lot. Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up,
  and all applicable mitigation measures. Must check in with Building Safety regarding any
  required permits. Applicant to hire a minimum of three (3) professional-licensed security
  guards for the safety of attendees and for traffic control of the parking lot. One security
  shall be at the entrance of the parking lot to serve as a traffic guide for vehicles entering
  the lot. One security guard shall be at the entrance of the pedestrian area to ensure there
  is no vehicle movement in the pedestrian area. In addition, a barrier or support barrier
  shall be in place to separate the pedestrian area from the parking lot. Security staff shall
  wear a reflective vest for visibility/risk management reasons. Applicant may use an “off-
  duty” law enforcement officer that is part of their organization in lieu of the security
  guards. The IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol and high visibility
  will be provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws. (Customer
  No. 0291767)
Business License Renewal Request (s):

  business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax; adhere to all
